drafts.subject: Re: Inquiry About jac-cloud Deployment on Kubernetes and Horizontal Scaling
drafts.message:
Hi Amara,

Thank you for reaching out with your questions about jac-cloud.

Yes, jac-cloud can be deployed on your own Kubernetes cluster, including Amazon EKS. We support integration with your existing cluster infrastructure to facilitate seamless deployment.

Regarding horizontal scaling of walkers, jac-cloud provides automatic scaling capabilities based on workload demand, so you do not need to manually manage replicas. This helps optimize resource usage and ensures efficient performance during load fluctuations.

If you have any further questions or need assistance with your Q4 infrastructure planning, feel free to reach out.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
